purpose: Manual acceptance questions for the Vulekamali assistant. Expected behaviour describes the capability to verify, not a fixed monetary answer.

questions.question: What was National Health allocated in 2026?
What was Eastern Cape Health allocated in 2026?
How much was Basic Education allocated in 2026-27?
questions.expected_behaviour: Return Basic Education, not Higher Education.

questions.question: How much was Higher Education and Training allocated in 2026?
How much was Education allocated in 2026?
questions.expected_behaviour: Show matching Basic, Higher and provincial Education departments separately.

questions.question: What was Police allocated in 2025-26?
How much did National Treasury receive in 2026?
How much did Treasury receive in 2026?
questions.expected_behaviour: Resolve Treasury alias to National Treasury.

questions.question: How much was SAPS allocated in 2026?
What was DHA allocated in 2026?
questions.expected_behaviour: Resolve DHA alias to Home Affairs.

What was the revised estimate for National Health in 2025-26?

questions.question: How much was National Health Programme 2 allocated in 2026?

questions.question: Show the ten largest National Health programmes in 2026.

questions.question: How much did Eastern Cape Health spend in 2026?

questions.question: What was the audited outcome for Health in 2026-27?
questions.expected_behaviour: Show National and provincial matches separately with actual years.

questions.question: How much did Health spend in 2026?
questions.expected_behaviour: No combined National/provincial total unless explicitly requested.

questions.question: How much did National Health underspend in 2024-25?
questions.expected_behaviour: Final appropriation versus audit outcome variance.

questions.question: Which national department underspent the most in 2024-25?
Did National Health overspend in 2024-25?
Compare National Health main appropriation with audit outcome in 2024-25.
Show National Health audited outcomes for the last three available financial years.
questions.expected_behaviour: Historic trend; each source year labelled.

questions.expected_behaviour: Rank entities using the sole available phase or Main appropriation.
